evals.name: review-and-fix-flagged-frames-only
evals.prompt:
The Metamorfiles project is at /path/to/project; pass that path to metamorfiles_get_project.

You are Studio's team on task t1, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). Review and fix only these frames, which Studio's checks flagged; don't review or change any other frame:
- pages/serum-launch instagram-story (b): Text "Brighter skin in two weeks of daily use" is clipped by its box.
Render the frames you changed again until no check errors remain.

Follow the metamorfiles-team skill (if this app didn't load it, call metamorfiles_get_guide with name "metamorfiles-team" first): report every step with metamorfiles_team_update and task "t1", and ask choices with metamorfiles_ask_user. This task runs in Auto: metamorfiles_ask_user takes your recommended option.

For the final check, use the design-reviewer agent.

You're running in the background and the user is watching in the control panel: don't include its link.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer, then the copywriter or designer, fix only the story frame of variant b, reporting each step; the final check goes to the design-reviewer agent; the summary is one or two plain sentences.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_team_update with task t1 before changing any file
Claims only frames of pages/serum-launch instagram-story variant b while working
Changes no file for other variants or formats
Every metamorfiles_team_update line is under eight words and names no file or tool
Hands the final check to the design-reviewer agent with only the project, item, changed frames and brief
Renders the changed frame again and leaves no check error
Ends each role with status done
The final summary is the agent's own, with no control panel link, hex value or pixel size

evals.name: copy-choice-asked-in-chat-mode
evals.prompt:
The Metamorfiles project is at /path/to/project; pass that path to metamorfiles_get_project.

You are Studio's team on task t2, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). The user asked: Make the headline punchier

Follow the metamorfiles-team skill (if this app didn't load it, call metamorfiles_get_guide with name "metamorfiles-team" first): report every step with metamorfiles_team_update and task "t2", and ask choices with metamorfiles_ask_user. This task runs in Chat: metamorfiles_ask_user waits for the user's answer.

For the final check, use the design-reviewer agent.

You're running in the background and the user is watching in the control panel: don't include its link.
evals.expected_output: The copywriter offers two or three headline angles with metamorfiles_ask_user, one recommended, waits for the answer, writes it within maxLength, and the designer re-fits the layout.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_ask_user with 2 to 4 options and exactly one recommended
Options differ in angle, not only in wording
Keeps calling with waitFor while the answer is waiting
The chosen headline fits the variable's maxLength
Introduces no claim, number or price that isn't in the brand or the page
